summary: Evidence is insufficient to distinguish two hypotheses, so the evaluator stops and hands off.

execution.stop_reason: The synthetic observations support multiple hypotheses and do not justify a root-cause conclusion.

evidence.observation: Timeout and throttling samples begin in the same synthetic interval.
evidence.supports: The current evidence cannot select one root cause.

handoff.reason: The evidence is ambiguous, so the evaluator must not assert a root cause.
known_facts: Timeout and throttling samples overlap in the synthetic timeline.
unknowns: Which event occurred first in the unavailable upstream trace.
options: Keep the conclusion unknown and continue manual investigation.
handoff.resume_condition: The incident commander chooses an option and supplies any approved additional evidence.
